name: Submit(v)
effect: versions[v] := (Tuple(v), SUBMITTED). No production authority is created.

name: SubmitEvidence(e)
effect: evidence[e] := (object, scope, uploader, UPLOADED, claimed validity interval).

name: Attest(e)
guard: evidence[e].status = UPLOADED ∧ `Matches(e,obj,q)` ∧ `Indep_L(attester(e), owner(e), q.clock)` for the level declared for attestation ∧ `Qualified(attester(e))`
effect: evidence[e].status := CURRENT if `SchemaOK(e)` ∧ `ValidityOK(e,q)` ∧ q.clock < validity_end(e); otherwise REJECTED.

name: Expire(e)
effect: evidence[e].status := EXPIRED. If e is effectiveness evidence and a risk criterion of a deployment j that credits it has the result BLOCKED in q, then j is added to estimates.ratchet (section 3.6).

name: RevokeEvidence(e)
effect: evidence[e].status := REVOKED, with revoker, reason and time recorded; the status is final. The same ratchet as Expire. Nothing else is assigned: the Status of every constraint that depended on e, the gate of every version that used e, and the residual estimate of every scenario that credited e are derived from the new evidence component (sections 3.3 and 4.6); for effectiveness evidence, π_c reverts to the case without effectiveness evidence and the estimate becomes the bounded estimate; an approval is not deleted, but it no longer satisfies ContinuingPass if the gate result is no longer releasable.

name: Reestimate(j,x)
effect: estimates.version(j) := x, a new estimate version; j is removed from estimates.ratchet.

name: Review(v,r)
guard: status(v) ∈ {SUBMITTED, APPROVED, DEPLOYED, SUPERSEDED, SUSPENDED} ∧ Gate(v,q) = REQUIRES_REVIEW ∧ every trigger of that result is resolvable by review (section 3.6) ∧ `Authorised(reviewer,Review,v,q)` ∧ `Indep_L(reviewer, owner(v), q.clock)` for the level declared for review
effect: review := review ∪ {(v, Tuple(v), q.policy, fingerprint of the triggers, reviewer, decision r ∈ {ACCEPT, REJECT}, q.clock, basis)}, where basis = (rationale, decision authority, evidence considered, expiry or review trigger). A record with an incomplete basis is stored but is not valid (see Releasable).

name: Approve(v)
effect: approval := approval ∪ {(Tuple(v), q.policy, approver, q.clock, expiry)}; status(v) := APPROVED.

name: Deploy(v)
effect: If prod = p ≠ none then status(p) := SUPERSEDED and the credentials of p are revoked. prod := v; status(v) := DEPLOYED; credentials of v are issued.

name: Update(v')
guard: `Authorised(actor,Update,v',q)` ∧ v' ∉ dom(versions) ∧ (`Tuple(v') ≠ Tuple(prod)` ∨ the change is declared)
effect: versions[v'] := (Tuple(v'), SUBMITTED). An approval bound to another tuple does not carry over to v'. prod is not assigned.

name: Rollback(v)
guard: status(v) = SUPERSEDED ∧ `ApprovedExactHash(v,q)` ∧ `Releasable(v,q)` ∧ `Authorised(actor,Rollback,v,q)` ∧ a rollback reason is given
effect: As Deploy(v): the current production version becomes SUPERSEDED, prod := v, status(v) := DEPLOYED. A rollback record is added to incidents.

name: Suspend(v)
effect: status(v) := SUSPENDED; prod := none; the credentials of v are revoked; the open obligation for v, if any, is closed. (A resumed version that still fails ContinuingPass opens a new obligation with a new deadline.)

name: Resume(v)
effect: As Deploy(v).

name: Flag(v)
guard: prod = v ∧ ¬`ContinuingPass(v,q)` ∧ no open obligation for v
effect: obligations := obligations ∪ {(v, OPEN, q.clock, deadline q.clock + d_c)}.

name: CloseObligation(o)
guard: o is open for a version v ∧ (prod ≠ v ∨ `ContinuingPass(v,q)`)
effect: status(o) := CLOSED.

name: Timeout(x)
guard: x is an open incident or an open obligation ∧ q.clock > deadline(x) ∧ no response has been recorded for x
effect: status(x) := BREACHED. The breach is evidence for the response constraint of section 3.5.1 and for the gate.

name: Observe(o)
guard: `Authorised(source(o),Observe,o,q)` ∧ the time and version of o are recorded
effect: runtime := runtime ⊕ `Derive(o)`.

name: Alert(a)
effect: incidents := incidents ∪ {Open(a, q.clock, deadline q.clock + d)}.

name: Respond(i,r)
effect: Record r and its evidence on i; status(i) := CLOSED if `Closure(i,r,q)`, otherwise unchanged.

name: Grant(p)
guard: the issuer is in `GrantAuthority(s,op,σ,I)` ∧ all required signatures and evidence are valid ∧ p ∉ dom(permissions)
effect: permissions[p] := the permission record with status ACTIVE.

name: Delegate(d)
guard: `AllowProvable(grantor,op,s,σ,q.clock)` through an active delegable parent ∧ op, σ and validity contained in the parent’s ∧ depth(d) ≤ Dmax ∧ the chain stays acyclic
effect: delegations[d] := the delegation record with status ACTIVE and source_permission_id := the parent.

name: Revoke(d)
effect: status(d) := REVOKED. Every descendant of d is invalid from the next state onward, in every later state, by the definition of Valid.

name: AssignRole(h)
guard: `Authorised(actor,AssignRole,h,q)` ∧ the interval of h is valid
effect: assignments := assignments ∪ {h}. A resulting role conflict is a constraint result (section 3.1.1), not a guard.

name: ChangePolicy(P')
guard: `Authorised(actor,ChangePolicy,P',q)` ∧ P' has a version number above q.policy
effect: policy := version(P'). Approvals and reviews bound to an earlier policy version are no longer valid.

name: Reorganise(r)
effect: structure := `Apply`(r, structure); the result need not be well formed, in which case WF(M) is false until it is corrected.

name: Decommission(v)
effect: prod := none if prod = v; the credentials of v are revoked; status(v) := DECOMMISSIONED; audit records are kept.

name: PlaceHold(d)
effect: retention[d].hold := TRUE.

name: RecordRetentionBasis(d)
effect: retention[d].basis := (retention basis, disposal method).

name: ReleaseHold(d)
effect: retention[d].hold := FALSE; retention[d].basis := none; every version with status RETIREMENT_VERIFIED whose Evidence(RETIREMENT_VERIFIED) no longer holds returns to DECOMMISSIONED.

name: DeleteData(d)
effect: retention[d].deleted := TRUE.

name: RetireVerify(v)
effect: status(v) := RETIREMENT_VERIFIED.

name: Tick(δ)
guard: δ ≥ 1 ∧ no urgent action is enabled (Expire(e), Flag(v), CloseObligation(o) or Timeout(x), for any argument) ∧ for every open incident or obligation x with deadline D(x): q.clock + δ ≤ D(x) or no authorised responder is available for x
effect: clock := clock + δ.
